provenance.source: Jayah, T.H., Aye, L., Fuller, R.J., Stewart, D.F. (2003). Biomass and Bioenergy 25(5), 459-469
provenance.description: Measured and predicted gas temperatures along the axis of the gasification zone, air-fuel ratio 2.20
provenance.digitisation: Digitised from the published figure at 300 dpi by locating marker centroids and the model line in pixel coordinates (axes: x 0-25 cm, y 0-2000 K). Estimated reading uncertainty +/-0.2 cm and +/-15 K.
provenance.note: The figure shows SIX experimental points. Chip size and moisture for this trial are not stated in the paper; the simulation uses 2.5 cm chips and 14.7 % d.b. (Table 5 / Run 7 values).
